primary_anchor_zh: 宽大球体和深色木质弧形支架
story_reason_zh: 地球仪被取去除尘，随后放回展示桌

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 大型古董地球仪在高窗古董室的圆桌上，以极慢速度旋转。
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 宽大球体和深色木质弧形支架占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 古董商缓慢搬起带支架的地球仪并从侧门离开画面；随后呈现空圆桌和后方高木窗。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 古董商缓慢搬起带支架的地球仪并从侧门离开画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 古董商缓慢将地球仪搬回画面并放回圆桌
shot_design.main_action_zh: 古董商缓慢将地球仪搬回画面并放回圆桌
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新清楚呈现宽大球体和深色木质弧形支架，物件占据足够画面面积。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed medium shot frames a large antique globe in a dark curved wooden stand on a round table in a tall-windowed antique room. The globe turns at a very slow pace. Warm daylight defines the broad globe and curved stand.

A fixed medium shot shows a large antique globe in a dark curved wooden stand on a round table in a tall-windowed antique room. An antique dealer slowly lifts the globe with its curved stand and carries it through a side doorway and out of frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty round table and the tall wooden window behind it. Dust motes drift through the window light.

A fixed medium shot holds on the empty round table and the tall wooden window behind it. An antique dealer slowly carries the large antique globe in a dark curved wooden stand back into frame and places it on a round table in a tall-windowed antique room.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 古董商缓慢搬起带支架的地球仪并从侧门离开画面
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 古董商缓慢将地球仪搬回画面并放回圆桌
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
